  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(var(--cst-title-min), 1fr) var(--cst-year-w) minmax(0, 2fr);

  transition: color .25s ease;
  z-index: 2;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  width: 100%;
}
.e-loop-item .cst-row * {
  color: inherit;
}
.e-loop-item .cst-col-title {
  font-weight: 600;

}
.e-loop-item .cst-col-year {
  text-align: center;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.e-loop-item .cst-col-desc {
  text-transform: none;
  white-space: normal;
  overflow: visible;
  text-overflow: clip;
  font-size: 0.9em;

/* Pointer & focus only for expandable rows */

  cursor: pointer;

  -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;

  --cst-ink: var(--cst-ink-active);

.e-loop-item .elementor-widget-divider .elementor-divider-separator,
